comment: Production happens ON an island and stays there until the network moves it. What an island produces is decided by its ROLE, which its owner sets after capture: 0 resource, 1 factory, 2 defence. worldgen's `kind` is not overridden by that - it is a terrainBonusPermil multiplier when the role suits the ground (resource-rich rock as Resource, natural fortress as Defence). A factory does not produce from nothing: it converts materials, per factory built, which is why a resource island is worth taking first. The ratio to remember: a factory eats factoryMaterialsIn per factory built per accrual, so three factories need 90 - which is one resource-rich mine, or two plain ones.

builds.comment: The island runway (manual item 2): land, refuel, relaunch - island-hopping is the range game.
The Long-Range Communication Pod (ruled 2026-08-25): fitted to ONE Manta, which then flies anywhere in the archipelago - the original's single exception to the telemetry leash.
